title: Google’s AI Didn’t Answer. It Built the App.
script: You didn’t open an app. You asked for one. Google Tabletop turns a prompt into a working tool for your group. Need an itinerary? It builds it. Dinner poll? Built. Expense splitter, tournament bracket, whatever the group needs. Everyone can edit together in real time, like a Google Doc. It’s still a limited US waitlist test. But the big shift is clear: AI isn’t just answering anymore. It’s making software on demand.
cta: Follow AI Tested for the next AI workflow shift.
concept: Product transformation: prompt becomes tool, rapid app cards, collaboration split, waitlist reality check, software-on-demand close.
